packageRules.description: Group all Compose UI libraries with the BOM. Compose pieces have to move together or compose-compiler / runtime version mismatches will surface at runtime.
Group all Media3 modules. They share a version and have to move together.
Group Room runtime/ktx/compiler/testing. Same coupling as media3.
Group Ktor client + serialization modules. They share a version.
Group Koin BOM and the modules that read it. BOM-managed versions need to stay in sync.
AGP and Kotlin move together. Kotlin major/minor changes usually require an AGP bump and vice versa; bundling avoids two PRs that have to land in lockstep.
KSP versions are pinned to a specific Kotlin version (e.g. 2.0.20-1.0.25). Group with the kotlin/agp PR so the two land together — KSP without a matching kotlin will fail to load.

Hold the AGP + Kotlin + KSP group on minor and major bumps while we're on Kotlin 2.0.20. Bumping any of these past the current minor pulls a kotlin-stdlib whose binary metadata kotlinc 2.0 cannot read, so the build dies before it even reaches our code. Patches still flow. When we plan a coordinated Kotlin upgrade (Gradle wrapper + AGP + Kotlin + KSP + a sweep of kotlin-coupled libs), remove this rule.
coil 3.1.0+ transitively pulls kotlin-stdlib 2.1+, incompatible with our kotlinc 2.0.20. Hold until the coordinated Kotlin upgrade lands.
Detekt and ktlint can move on their own — they're CI-only and breakage is loud.
GitHub Actions used in workflows. One PR per week for any pinned-version action bumps.
Major version bumps always need a human look. Never auto-merge them even after we flip patches on.
